summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY with hands-on GPU performance engineering experience: custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing and constant memory that cut VGG16 inference from 77.5 ms to 49.2 ms. Profiled and optimized LLM inference on NVIDIA hardware, reducing TinyLlama VRAM ~55% through 8-bit quantization with under 1% accuracy loss. Coursework in High Performance Architecture and Multiple Processor Systems.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Optimized a high-resolution image-stitching pipeline using bit manipulation, averaging, and concurrency, raising PSNR from 65 to 86 over a homography-based baseline.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT, an OCR-free vision-encoder-decoder transformer, in PyTorch using the HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API with domain-specific special tokens and a resized decoder embedding layer.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% through preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for constrained-device inference.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Coalesced CUDA kernel ran at 49.2 ms vs 73.3 ms uncoalesced and 77.5 ms CPU TorchScript, a ~35% speedup over naive GPU with identical classification accuracy.

Replaced TorchScript convolution layers with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing, constant memory for weights and biases, and preallocated global buffers to eliminate per-layer allocation overhead.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Accelerator Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency across prompt types using pynvml and psutil.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC with under 1% accuracy degradation and +0.09 perplexity increase, characterizing the efficiency-versus-accuracy trade-off for accelerator deployment.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch: multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, layer norm, and weight tying; trained with a custom loop and perplexity evaluation.

projects.name: TensorRT Inference Optimization (M.S. Capstone, RIT)
bullets: Optimized YOLO inference with TensorRT on NVIDIA Jetson for 5.2x speedup: 56.7 ms to 10.9 ms, 17.6 to 92 FPS versus eager PyTorch, integrated into a real-time visual servoing loop.

projects.name: Parallel Ray Tracer with MPI Task Scheduling
bullets: Achieved up to 30x speedup with static strip partitioning across 55 MPI processes on 5000x5000 pixel scenes; benchmarked four work-distribution strategies against unpredictable workloads.
